case: shadowed-search_path enum metadata and consumer behavior through 64 nested domains
contract: The native contract checks domain-over-enum chains at depths 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 63 and 64 while search_path resolves a same-named shadow enum.

At every tested depth, recursive catalog metadata resolves the target enum leaf; schema-aware keyed updates, label and SQL NULL draft inserts, typed equality filters, and exact outer-domain/native value checks succeed.
At depths through 63, raw inferred SQL NULL updates succeed with the outer domain type preserved, and an invalid raw text label is refused by PostgreSQL with SQLSTATE 22P02.

At depth 64, SQLx cannot resolve inferred text or SQL NULL parameter type OIDs within its 64-step resolver limit; BookieE maps both failures to an explicit Unsupported result instead of an internal error, and neither operation mutates the row.
Same-backend search_path changes and rollback checks preserve exact native values and types at every tested depth.
